comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts an industrial gripper opening stop; PR-2107 extends and locks a suitcase handle at full height.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires two-tool countertorque and regrasping; PR-2107 requires holding a case while maintaining a release-button press through a long telescoping stroke.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades a jam-nut-secured angle retained over cycles; PR-2107 grades both rails locked at 520 mm with the case stable and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Although both end in a locked mechanical setting, the underlying tested abilities—countertorque adjustment versus button-held telescoping—are different.
